package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- store/store.go --
package store

type Log struct{ Kind string }

//fabrik:provider
func NewLog() *Log { return &Log{Kind: "app"} }

//fabrik:provider name=access
func NewAccessLog() *Log { return &Log{Kind: "access"} }
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"app/store"
)

//fabrik:inject log name=access
//fabrik:http:middleware name=audit
func Audit(log *store.Log) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }
}

//fabrik:http GET /{$} middleware=audit
func Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/store"
	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		storeLogAccess := store.NewAccessLog()
		r := router.New()

		// Middleware
		auditMW := web.Audit(storeLogAccess)

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/{$}", web.Home, auditMW)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
